formula: It was not long before + subject + past verb + other information

formulas.formula: It was not long before + subject + past verb + other information

example: It was not long before the team discovered another problem.
exampleZh: 沒過多久，團隊便發現了另一個問題。

examples.en: It was not long before the team discovered another problem.
examples.zh: 沒過多久，團隊便發現了另一個問題。
examples.highlight: It was not long before the team discovered another problem.

rules.zh: 後面必須接完整子句正確：【It was not long before the train arrived.】 沒過多久，列車便到達。 錯誤：【It was not long before the train’s arrival.】 本課的目標句型要求 before 後面有主語和動詞：主語 arrived = 動詞
rules.en: Before It was not long before the train arrived. It was not long before the train’s arrival. the train =

rules.zh: 的真正意思是「時間很短」不是指「列車沒有到達」。它表示：【The train arrived soon.】 列車很快便到達。 因此，整個結構雖然有 not，但它表達的是某件事很快發生。
rules.en: Not long It was not long before the train arrived. The train arrived soon.

rules.zh: 兩件事有先後次序事情的次序是：會議開始；過了很短時間；兩名成員出現分歧。學生必須保留兩件事的正確先後次序。
rules.en: After the meeting began, it was not long before two members disagreed.

rules.zh: 子句通常使用過去式因為 It was not long 建立了過去時間，後面的事件通常也使用過去式。
rules.en: Before It was not long before the baby fell asleep. It was not long before the error appeared again. It was not long before the roads were closed.

rules.zh: 可使用縮寫，但答案統一使用完整形式日常說話中常見：【It wasn’t long before the baby fell asleep.】 本練習的參考答案統一使用：【It was not long before the baby fell asleep.】 兩者意思相同，但完整形式較方便學生辨認句型。
rules.en: It wasn’t long before the baby fell asleep. It was not long before the baby fell asleep.

rules.zh: 與 Before long 的分別沒過多久，團隊便發現了另一個問題。 不久，團隊便發現了另一個問題。 兩者意思相近，但語法不同：目標表達【It was not long before】是完整的時間句型；目標表達【Before long】是副詞詞組，意思近似 soon。本練習要求使用：【It was not long before + clause】
rules.en: It was not long before + clause It was not long before the team discovered another problem. Before long, + clause Before long, the team discovered another problem. It was not long before Before long It was not long before + clause

rules.zh: 與 It was not until 的分別團隊很快便發現了錯誤。 重點：事情很快發生。直到星期五，團隊才發現錯誤。 重點：事情到了某個較遲的時間才發生。簡單分辨：很快便發生直到某時才發生
rules.en: It was not long before It was not long before the team found the error. It was not until It was not until Friday that the team found the error. not long before = not until =

rules.zh: 本課不包括未來式變化未來情況可以使用：【It will not be long before + present-tense clause.】 天氣很快便會好轉。 不過，本練習只集中訓練過去式：【It was not long before + past-tense clause.】
rules.en: It will not be long before + present-tense clause. It will not be long before the weather improves. It was not long before + past-tense clause.

benefits.zh: 清楚顯示兩件事相隔時間很短這個句型不只表示兩件事先後發生，還能讓讀者知道第二件事很快便出現。這兩句只交代事情的次序。這句進一步說明第一名顧客很快便到達。
benefits.en: The shop opened. The first customer arrived. Once the shop opened, it was not long before the first customer arrived.

benefits.zh: 適合敘述事件的發展你可以用這個句型說明一件事如何迅速引出另一件事，例如：問題很快出現；顧客很快作出反應；情況很快改善；門票很快售罄；某人很快發現錯誤。因此，它很適合故事、新聞、報告和事件摘要。
benefits.en: This structure clearly narrates how one event quickly led to another—for example, a problem appeared, customers reacted, conditions improved, tickets sold out or someone discovered an error. It suits stories, news, reports and event summaries.

benefits.zh: 把兩個短句連成一個有明確關係的句子較簡單的寫法：【The alarm sounded. Everyone soon left the building.】 使用目標句型：【When the alarm sounded, it was not long before everyone left the building.】 第二個版本能更清楚地連接兩件事。
benefits.en: The alarm sounded. Everyone soon left the building. When the alarm sounded, it was not long before everyone left the building.

benefits.zh: 避免重複使用 soon 和 shortly after 學生經常使用：【soon；shortly afterwards；shortly after；a few minutes later】 提供另一種自然的表達方式，令說話和寫作不會過度重複。
benefits.en: soon shortly afterwards shortly after a few minutes later It was not long before

benefits.zh: 可以改變句子的開首和組織你可以使用不同方法開始句子：【It was not long before...；After..., it was not long before...；Once..., it was not long before...；When..., it was not long before...；Following..., it was not long before...；With..., it was not long before...】 這些變化能令文章的句子開首更多樣化。
benefits.en: It was not long before... After..., it was not long before... Once..., it was not long before... When..., it was not long before... Following..., it was not long before... With..., it was not long before...

benefits.zh: 可以配合主動和被動語態主動：【It was not long before customers demanded refunds.】 沒過多久，顧客便要求退款。 被動：【It was not long before all the tickets were booked.】 沒過多久，所有門票便被預訂了。 因此，這個句型可以靈活地描述人物的行動或事情受到的影響。
benefits.en: It was not long before customers demanded refunds. It was not long before all the tickets were booked.
